executionLinux.method: Fixed prestate; EIP-1559 Cancun transact/discard; 100 correctness/warm-up replays per fixture. Timed loop includes transaction validation, interpretation, precompiles and journal cleanup. Excludes JSON/RPC, state import, persistent commit, block production, JIT, transaction signature recovery and consensus. Alternating forward/reverse fixture order.

executionMac.counter_error: Linux perf_event hardware counters required; wall/thread CPU time are measured separately
